title: "Antivirulence activity of 3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid via interference of quorum sensing regulators in Pseudomonas aeruginosa".
authors: Corona-Vazquez, Maricarmen; Santos-Briones, Cesar de Los; Hernandez-Nunez, Emanuel; Hernandez-Bolio, Gloria I; Pena-Rodriguez, Luis Manuel; Canto-Canche, Blondy
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三萜类化合物通过干扰铜绿假单胞菌群体感应转录调控因子（LasR等）发挥抗毒力作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（转录因子调控）和分子对接，但对象为细菌QS系统而非TF-DNA特异性结合，方法以湿实验为主、对接为辅，与本课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: 3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid, a ceanothane-type triterpene from Colubrina yucatanensis, was previously shown to inhibit biofilm and reduce virulence factors in Pseudomonas aeruginosa. PURPOSE: To investigate the quorum sensing (QS)-related antivirulence mechanism of 3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid. STUDY DESIGN: Exploratory study combining in vitro bioassays and in silico analysis. METHODS: QS inhibition was assessed with Chromobacterium violaceum CV026, and biofilm formation was evaluated in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14 WT and DeltalasR/DeltarhlR strains. Expression of QS regulators was measured by Real-Time -PCR. Molecular docking analyses evaluated binding affinities of 3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid to key QS targets. RESULTS: 3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid decreased lasR and pqsR expression, two key QS trasncritional regulators, suggesting interference with QS-regulated phenotypes. Docking supported preferential interaction with LasR and variable affinities across other targets. CONCLUSIONS: 3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid from C. yucatanensis emerge as promising antivirulence agents against P. aeruginosa, opening an avenue for the study of other ceanothane triterpenes as anti-QS agents.
abstract_zh: 背景：3-O-乙酰基美洲茶酸（3-O-acetyl-ceanothic acid），一种来自尤卡坦美洲茶（Colubrina yucatanensis）的美洲茶烷型三萜，先前已被证明能抑制铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）的生物膜形成并降低其毒力因子。目的：研究3-O-乙酰基美洲茶酸的群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）相关抗毒力机制。研究设计：结合体外生物测定和计算机模拟分析的探索性研究。方法：使用紫色杆菌（Chromobacterium violaceum）CV026评估QS抑制效果，并在铜绿假单胞菌PA14野生型及DeltalasR/DeltarhlR菌株中评估生物膜形成。通过实时PCR（Real-Time -PCR）测量QS调节因子的表达。分子对接分析评估3-O-乙酰基美洲茶酸与关键QS靶标的结合亲和力。结果：3-O-乙酰基美洲茶酸降低了lasR和pqsR的表达，这两个是关键的QS转录调节因子，表明其干扰了QS调控的表型。对接结果支持其与LasR的优先相互作用，并显示与其他靶标的亲和力存在差异。结论：来自尤卡坦美洲茶的3-O-乙酰基美洲茶酸成为针对铜绿假单胞菌的有前景的抗毒力剂，为研究其他美洲茶烷型三萜作为抗QS剂开辟了途径。
